title: Breaking Bad News in the Era of Artificial Intelligence and Algorithmic Medicine: An Exploration of Disclosure and its Ethical Justification using the Hedonic Calculus
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to the ethical evaluation of AI-driven medical disclosures using the philosophical framework of Utilitarianism (Bentham's Felicific Calculus). It investigates moral justification, ethical domains like intensity and duration of pain/pleasure, and touches on spiritual preferences in the context of end-of-life communication.
